errors.quote: protein higher or lower than expected **given RNA
errors.issue: Observed RNA is noisy and incompletely captured; residual protein variation conditioned on measured RNA can arise without genuine post-transcriptional differences. Specify and validate the joint measurement-error model before mechanistic attribution.

errors.quote: Discordance disappears after depth matching or downsampling analysis
errors.issue: Downsampling can destroy power to observe genuine low-abundance biology. Disappearance alone is not evidence that the original effect was technical; compare calibrated effect recovery, sensitivity and uncertainty.

errors.quote: a condition has major loss of viable singlets
errors.issue: Treatment-linked viability/complexity changes can be real outcomes. Repeating a condition until this difference disappears risks selection; preserve attrition and distinguish demonstrated assay failure from biological toxicity.

errors.quote: Confirm selected transcript changes in bulk or orthogonal assays
errors.issue: Separate bulk/aliquot RNA and protein validation cannot by itself verify the same-cell joint discordance or frequency of a proposed state. Add paired single-cell validation or limit inference to population trajectories.

errors.quote: Examples cannot be specified from the packet
errors.issue: The instruction permits clearly labeled proposed choices. The plan leaves model, target, perturbation, actual antibody workflow, time grid and count-model family entirely unselected, substantially limiting actionability.

errors.quote: criteria for classifying an outcome as supporting M1, M2, M3, or M4
errors.issue: No quantitative discrimination margin, independent-unit power/precision calculation or implemented fitting/comparison procedure is supplied. Pre-registering a future choice is not an executed proposed analysis design.

rationale: Useful alternative time-course and surface-versus-total-protein design with independent biological replication and honest proposal labeling. Residual interpretation, QC selection and deferred implementation limit quality. It deliberately prioritizes target-level validation over adaptive cell-specific integration, which is a historical miss rather than an automatic scientific failure.
reference_guardrails: Complete final answer, packet, reference and sealed target personally read. Original rubric only; strict-round penalties not active.
Cell-specific learned modality utility and an explicit integrated neighborhood construction are essential for this historical target; generic calibrated weighting or a graph mention is insufficient.
Donor splitting must precede fitted transformations and tuning. Condition blinding does not replace independent endpoint validation or prevent marker-label circularity.

A technical-null mismatch need not define a new cell state. Low-count/QC correlation does not prove artifact. Use known-control calibration, independent phenotypes and quantitative sensitivity analyses.
